cards.q: What gas do plants absorb from the air for photosynthesis?
cards.note: They release oxygen as a by-product.

cards.q: What is the largest planet in our solar system?
cards.note: More than 1,300 Earths could fit inside it.

cards.q: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
How many bones are in the adult human body?
cards.note: Babies are born with around 270; some fuse as they grow.

cards.q: At what temperature does water boil at sea level?
cards.note: At higher altitude it boils at a lower temperature.

cards.q: Which organ cleans the blood and produces urine?
cards.note: Each one filters about 50 gallons of blood a day.

cards.q: What is the hardest natural substance?
cards.note: It is made of carbon atoms in a rigid structure.

cards.q: How long does light from the Sun take to reach Earth?
What is the largest mammal on Earth?
cards.note: It can be over 30 metres long.

cards.q: What part of the cell holds most of its DNA?
cards.note: Mitochondria carry a small amount of their own DNA too.
